meta.name: deepchem
meta.description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.

copy.tagline: 预测分子性质，加速化学与药物研发

copy.tagline_en: Predict molecular properties to accelerate drug discovery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly evaluate ADMET and toxicity properties for many molecules

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude能处理化学分子数据，把分子转成数字特征，训练模型预测性质（如毒性、溶解度），也能调用现成基准数据集和预训练模型。
howto.when: 当你想用Claude做分子性质预测、把分子转成特征，或使用MoleculeNet等基准数据集时触发。

say.text: 用DeepChem预测这个分子的毒性，SMILES是CC(C)O。
say.note: 会调用DeepChem加载数据并输出预测。

say.text: 帮我用Tox21数据集训练一个图神经网络模型。
用ScaffoldSplitter分割数据，再训练随机森林模型。
say.note: 会按分子骨架分割数据并训练模型。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude work with molecular data: featurize molecules, train models for property prediction (toxicity, solubility), and use built-in benchmarks and pretrained models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to predict molecular properties, featurize molecules, or use MoleculeNet benchmark datasets.

say_en.text: Use DeepChem to predict toxicity for this molecule, SMILES is CC(C)O.
say_en.note: Loads data via DeepChem and outputs a prediction.

say_en.text: Train a GNN model on the Tox21 dataset.
say_en.note: Downloads Tox21 data and trains a GCN.

say_en.text: Split data with ScaffoldSplitter and train a Random Forest model.
say_en.note: Splits by molecular scaffold and trains the model.
